 Thursday Morning Links
 by Benjamin Morris Oct 22, 2026, 2:05 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 If you buy something from a link, Vox Media may earn a commission. See our ethics statement. 
 Morning, all!
 The Brewers and the Rays have gone to the World Series on a budget, but there are ways the Rangers can change their approach on the field to get more out of what they have.
 One of the things that Chris Young has said the Rangers need to improve is ““athleticism,” and the Rays and the Brewers are two of the league’s most aggressive teams on the basepaths. https://www.mlb.com/news/world-series-2026-brewers-rays-speed-stolen-bases-matchup 
 Three of the bright spots on the 2026 Ranger roster were 3 or 4 year players that had been developed by the Rangers internally.
